about.title: About PDFCraft
about.description: PDFCraft is a professional online PDF tools platform designed to help you work with PDF files efficiently and securely.
about.missionText: We believe working with PDFs should be simple, fast, and accessible to everyone. PDFCraft provides powerful tools that make PDF management effortless — no installation required.
about.fastDescription: Process your PDFs in seconds with our optimized server-side technology.
about.secureDescription: Your files are encrypted in transit and automatically deleted after processing.
about.easyToUseDescription: A clean, intuitive interface that requires no learning curve.
